reason: I already have Discord and a reader site for the stuff I read, so I don't see a reason to switch to some random new site just for these two series.
objection: I don't want my reading or chat activity stored somewhere random, and 'invite only' doesn't really tell me much about who actually runs it.
would_change_my_mind: If it was hosted by someone I actually knew and trusted, and I could see exactly what data was being collected
